binding: Trusted installed CLI helpers; optional local MCP server can expose the same tools. Not codex mcp-server.

tools.name: inspect_sources
tools.contract: Read authorized workspace inputs, signatures, sheets/pages and content samples; can invoke installed readers.

tools.name: measure_scope
tools.contract: Trusted deterministic unitizer and size/hash meter; Agent consumes signed counts, cannot change billing scope.

tools.name: read_document
tools.contract: Optional text/PDF/DOCX/XLSX readers; one method among those Agent may choose.

tools.name: render_or_ocr
tools.contract: Optional page render/image/OCR tool with preserved page/bbox; allowed units only.

tools.name: run_generated_script
tools.contract: Agent writes and runs Python/Node cleaning code inside workspace; no execution of uploaded code/macros.

tools.name: write_candidates
tools.contract: Write proposals, evidence/lineage/coverage ledgers and all nine candidate artifacts.

tools.name: validate_candidates
tools.contract: Call read-only trusted validator, receive checks/issues; Agent may repair its candidate files.

tools.name: record_checkpoint
tools.contract: Request durable snapshot of already-written files; host verifies hashes and current lease.

toolkit_role: Capability library only; Agent can inspect, choose, combine and write custom transformations. Independent validator is outside its write permission.
